name: GoCardless UK Banks
description: Import transactions from any UK bank supported by GoCardless, with multiple bank connections
author: Robert

permissions.purpose: List your Wealthfolio accounts so each connected bank account can be mapped to one, and create a matching cash account when you ask for it
Validate and import transactions from all connected banks as deposits and withdrawals
Store your shared GoCardless credentials and access token in the OS keyring, and let Wealthfolio inject the bearer token into brokered requests
Call the GoCardless Bank Account Data API at bankaccountdata.gocardless.com to list institutions and read balances and transactions for every connected bank
